    • deleteById

      protected Optional<EntityLimit> deleteById(Integer id)
      Rejects deletion of the default row of a registered MAX key. Its value is editable, the row itself is permanent: deleting it would silently turn a mandatory cap into no cap, because a key with no row at all resolves as unlimited. Role and user override rows, and every daily row, stay freely deletable.
      Overrides:
      deleteById in class UpdateCreateDeleteAudit<EntityLimit>
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the entity to delete.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the deleted entity if found and deleted, otherwise an empty Optional (though exceptions are thrown for not found or no rights).
